topic: Day 40 — carousel — Physical closeness without emotional honesty is just proximity

slides.text: You can be physically close and still be strangers.
The emotional layer underneath was never actually built.
That's the part that decides if closeness means anything.

caption:
You can be as physically close to someone as possible and still be strangers, if the emotional layer underneath was never built.

Follow for one of these a day.
